task_production_rates.name: Inspect Ceiling Drywall
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walking inspection overhead, slightly slower than wall inspection due to neck angle

task_production_rates.name: Inspect Ceiling Drywall (Premium)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Detailed inspection with work light overhead

task_production_rates.name: Inspect Wall Drywall
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walking inspection at approximately 1 minute per 100 SF, marking defects

task_production_rates.name: Inspect Wall Drywall (Premium)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Detailed inspection with work light, marking all imperfections

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Ceiling Drywall Dust
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Overhead vacuum with extension pole, slower than wall vacuum

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Wall Drywall Dust
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: HEPA vacuum with brush attachment, thorough pass

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Subfloor (Pre-Prime)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shop vacuum of subfloor to remove fallen drywall dust, faster than surface vacuum

task_production_rates.name: Mask Window Openings
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Apply masking film and tape perimeter per window opening

task_production_rates.name: Mask Exterior Doors
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Apply masking film and tape perimeter per door, larger than windows

task_production_rates.name: Protect Recessed Lights and Electrical Boxes
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Stuff and tape ~16 items per room (6 lights + 10 electrical boxes average). ~20 min per room.

task_production_rates.name: Cover Building Materials and Tools
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed time per job to cover materials in work area with plastic

task_production_rates.name: Roll Primer on Ceilings
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Single journeyman, 9-inch roller with pole, overhead work slower than walls

task_production_rates.name: Roll Primer on Textured Ceilings
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Textured surface requires more product and slower application overhead

task_production_rates.name: Roll Primer on Walls
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Single journeyman, 9-inch roller, 8-10 ft walls, smooth drywall

task_production_rates.name: Roll Primer on Textured Walls
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Textured surface requires more product and slower application

task_production_rates.name: Spray Primer on Ceilings
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray overhead, coupled to backroll rate. Spray at this rate, backroll limits system.

task_production_rates.name: Backroll Sprayed Ceiling Primer
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 18-inch roller overhead, sets pace for spray+backroll system. This is the bottleneck.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Primer on Walls
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray on walls, coupled to backroll rate

task_production_rates.name: Backroll Sprayed Wall Primer
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 18-inch roller on walls, sets pace for spray+backroll system

task_production_rates.name: Spray Primer on Ceilings (No Backroll)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Spray-only overhead, no backroll coupling constraint

task_production_rates.name: Spray Primer on Walls (No Backroll)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Spray-only on walls, no backroll coupling constraint

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Subfloors (Post-Prime Cleanup)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shop vacuum of subfloor to remove primer drips and debris

task_production_rates.name: Remove Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove masking from fixtures and electrical per room, ~10 min per room

task_production_rates.name: Clean Tools
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed time per job to clean all tools

task_production_rates.name: Final Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walking inspection of completed primer work (ceiling + wall SF combined)

task_production_rates.name: Final Inspection (Premium)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Detailed inspection with work light, touch up all imperfections

quality_tier_effects.description: Minimal prime - reduced prep, basic coverage only
quality_tier_effects.notes: Economy work: quick inspection, basic vacuum, coverage-only application

quality_tier_effects.description: Standard prime - baseline for all rates
quality_tier_effects.notes: Standard new construction: proper prep, single coat, complete coverage

quality_tier_effects.description: Premium prime - thorough prep, careful application
quality_tier_effects.notes: Premium work: detailed inspection, thorough vacuum, uniform coverage

texture_effects.notes: Orange peel texture increases surface area ~15%, slows application ~15%
Knockdown texture increases surface area ~25%, slows application ~20%

drywall_level_effects.notes: Level 3 has more exposed paper, higher absorption, slightly slower application
Level 5 is uniform surface, slightly better coverage

coupling_constraints.description: When using spray+backroll on ceilings, spray rate must not exceed backroll rate. Backroller sets the pace.
coupling_constraints.practical_implication: Spray at 500 SF/hr, backroll at 350 SF/hr means effective ceiling rate is 350 SF/hr per crew
coupling_constraints.notes: Spray and backroll done by 2-person crew working in tandem, bottleneck is backroll

coupling_constraints.description: When using spray+backroll on walls, spray rate must not exceed backroll rate. Backroller sets the pace.
coupling_constraints.practical_implication: Spray at 600 SF/hr, backroll at 400 SF/hr means effective wall rate is 400 SF/hr per crew
coupling_constraints.notes: Spray and backroll done by 2-person crew working in tandem, bottleneck is backroll

crew_configurations.name: Single Roller
crew_configurations.notes: One person does all rolling (ceilings and walls)

crew_configurations.name: Roller Pair
crew_configurations.notes: Two rollers can work in parallel after ceiling has head start

crew_configurations.name: Spray + Backroll Crew
crew_configurations.notes: Sprayer and backroller work in tandem. Backroller sets pace.
